description.de: Auf Konzeptseiten begrenzte Variante des bestehenden Docs-DE→EN-Delta-Syncs: ein Übersetzungsaufruf je Datei, getrennte Arbeitsdateien je Run, englische Diagrammlabels und ein deterministisches Gate; concept_only übersetzt nur einzelne Seiten.
description.en: Concept-page scope of the existing docs DE→EN delta sync: one translation call per file, separate work files per run, English diagram labels and a deterministic gate; concept_only translates single pages only.

author: MySuricates
instructions: Faithful German-to-English documentation sync, derived from Docs DE→EN Sync (delta). Work only in the explicit translation_root. No commits, pushes, API calls or TODO changes.

config.command:
set -euo pipefail
python3 {{ translation_root }}/scripts/concepts/pages.py check --root {{ translation_root }} --work {{ translation_root }}/docs/konzepte --facts {{ translation_root }}/docs/konzepte/betriebsdaten.json --only {{ concept_only }}
mkdir -p {{ translation_output }}/{{ workflow_run_id }} {{ translation_root }}/docs/en/konzepte
date -u +%F > {{ translation_output }}/{{ workflow_run_id }}/date.txt

You translate ONE documentation file from German to English. Relative path within docs/: {{ relpath }}

This IS a real file task — use the shell to read the source, then write the result file. Do not skip the writes.

STEP 1 — Read the German source and the sync date:
```bash
cat "{{ translation_root }}/docs/{{ relpath }}"
echo "=== SYNC DATE ==="
cat {{ translation_output }}/{{ workflow_run_id }}/date.txt
```

STEP 2 — Translate the source to fluent, idiomatic English. Rules:
- Preserve ALL Markdown EXACTLY: headers, tables (same column count + alignment), fenced code blocks, links, blockquotes, HTML comments, footnotes, and ```mermaid```/```diagram``` blocks.
- Keep VERBATIM (do NOT translate): file paths (e.g. docs/architektur.md, src/main/java/...), class/method names, API endpoints, variable & env-var names, shell commands, URLs, config keys, code examples, and identifier-like table values.
- Internal links to sibling docs stay RELATIVE and UNCHANGED (e.g. [Architektur](architektur.md), (deployment.md), (onboarding/FAQ.md)). The English file lives in docs/en/ next to the other English docs, so the same relative link resolves to the English sibling. Do NOT rewrite paths to docs/en/.
- Translate ONLY natural-language German prose, headings, list items, table-cell prose, image alt-text, and captions.
- Keep the pragmatic, factual tone of the German original — no marketing, no hype, no added commentary. Translate faithfully; do not rewrite, summarize, or embellish.

STEP 3 — Write the COMPLETE English file to {{ translation_root }}/docs/en/{{ relpath }} (full content, not a diff). First create the parent directory:
```bash
mkdir -p "{{ translation_root }}/docs/en/$(dirname "{{ relpath }}")"
```
The FIRST line of the file MUST be exactly:
<!-- last-sync: DATE from: docs/{{ relpath }} -->
where DATE is the value you read from {{ translation_output }}/{{ workflow_run_id }}/date.txt. Then ONE blank line, then the full translated content.

Write {{ translation_root }}/docs/en/{{ relpath }} with your file-write tool (NOT a heredoc, to avoid escaping issues). Do NOT modify the German source.

STEP 4 — Verify you actually wrote it:
```bash
head -3 "{{ translation_root }}/docs/en/{{ relpath }}" && echo "lines:" && wc -l < "{{ translation_root }}/docs/en/{{ relpath }}"
```


Additional rules for the concept-page scope:
- Read and write ONLY the absolute translation_root paths above, regardless of the process working directory.
- Preserve all HTML provenance comments and Mermaid code VERBATIM; deterministic post-processing supplies English diagram labels and fixes links that move one level deeper.
- Use exactly these translated section headings for concept pages:
  Wofür taugt das? -> What is it useful for?
  Vorteile -> Benefits
  Nachteile und Kosten -> Drawbacks and costs
  Betriebsbeleg -> Operational evidence
  Im Code -> In the code
- Preserve every measurement value and denominator exactly. Do not invent percentages or update measurements.
- Translate README.md too when selected; preserve code samples and paths exactly.
- The parent operator owns TODO tracking. Do not change TODOs, call the platform API/DB, commit or push.
